text:
jess (support): Hey folks, ticket #4251 — customer uploaded a debug bundle that includes the user prompt with PII. We need a sanitized repro bundle + curl reproduction we can paste into the ticket. They also gave two request IDs: req_9f4b2a and req_9f4b2b. Can eng take the lead on making a redacted repro and call out which fields we removed?

sam (support): Thanks Jess. Can you attach the original bundle and the zendesk ticket link? Also confirm whether customer consented to us looking at raw prompts.

jess (support): Attached to the ticket now: https://redwood.zendesk.com/agent/tickets/4251 — customer gave consent in the thread but asked that any shared artifact have personal data removed before external sharing.

maria (eng-oncall): I pulled the bundle. Repro steps below and an example sanitized curl. I replaced the prompt with [REDACTED_PROMPT] and API key with X-REDACTED. Please do NOT share the original bundle outside the ticket.

```
# sanitized repro curl (replace HOST with staging/redwood API host)
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer X-REDACTED" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-large-v1","input":"[REDACTED_PROMPT]","max_tokens":256}'
```

maria (eng-oncall): For logs, scrub these fields before attaching elsewhere: user.email, user.name, phone_number (keep last 2 digits as Xs is okay), and any account IDs. Also replace request IDs if you need to share publicly. Example sed to redact request ids in a log file: 

```bash
sed -E 's/(req_[0-9a-f]{6})/REQ_REDACTED/g' original.log > sanitized.log
```

security-bot: Redaction checklist (quick):
- Remove or tokenise names, emails, phone numbers, street addresses.
- Replace full prompt text with high-level summary or [REDACTED_PROMPT].
- Replace API keys/authorization headers.
- If sharing externally, run the bundle through internal sanitizer: `redwood-cli bundle sanitize --pii --strip-logs` and verify manually.

ops-oncall: We have an internal debug bundle uploaded at https://internal-s3.redwood/debug/1747001234.zip (access: eng/support only). Do not copy that link into customer-facing messages. If you need a customer-safe zip, create a new sanitized archive and attach to Zendesk.

support-bot: Debug bundle processor finished scanning. Findings: 2 occurrences of email-like tokens, 1 phone-like token, 2 request ids (req_9f4b2a, req_9f4b2b). Generated sanitized bundle -> https://internal-s3.redwood/sanitized/1747001234-sanitized.zip (internal only).

jess (support): I uploaded the sanitized bundle to the Zendesk ticket (attachment id: 8793) and added a short note about what we removed. I also pasted Maria's sanitized curl into the private agent notes for engineers.

maria (eng-oncall): One more note for repro: the error happens on streaming token N around 120 and seems tied to a KV cache mismatch. If you need to reproduce locally, run with `--max-tokens 256 --streaming=false` to see if it still fails. If you share the sanitized curl externally, please keep the body truncated and include the steps rather than the original prompt.

sam (support): Perfect. I'll reply to the customer with the sanitized summary and confirm we won't share the original. Attaching private bundle to the ticket now. :thumbsup:

jess (support): Thanks team — closing internal thread. If anyone finds additional PII in downstream logs, ping me and we'll rotate any leaked tokens and re-run redaction.
